title: session_handler: KITH_BASE_URL deprecation uses eprintln! instead of tracing::warn
description: session_handler reads KITH_BASE_URL and prints deprecation notice via eprintln!, bypassing the structured tracing infrastructure. Log aggregators capturing tracing output will never see this warning. No removal timeline documented. Fix: replace eprintln! with tracing::warn! so the notice appears in structured logs; add a comment with a planned removal version.
